item.text:
**3B.2 Research Note: Ali Khamenei in 2024**

**Bottom line:** the 2024 evidence is strongly negative. I found repeated abuse by security organs and no credible sign that Khamenei meaningfully punished police, intelligence, prison, or other coercive actors for it. The only positive evidence is limited, discretionary clemency for selected prisoners, which does not amount to disciplining abusive forces.

| Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `Iran: Draconian campaign to enforce compulsory veiling laws through surveillance and mass car confiscations` | Amnesty International | 2024-03-06 | [link](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/03/iran-draconian-campaign-to-enforce-compulsory-veiling-laws-through-surveillance-and-mass-car-confiscations/) | Amnesty said Iranian authorities were waging a large-scale 2024 campaign to enforce veiling laws through surveillance, mass police checks, confiscations, prosecutions, flogging, prison terms, and “morality” classes, with multiple state agencies involved. This is direct evidence of tolerated abuse by police and security institutions. | `3B.2`, `3B.1` |
| `Iran: Two years after ‘Woman Life Freedom’ uprising, impunity for crimes reigns supreme` | Amnesty International | 2024-09-11 | [link](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/iran-two-years-after-woman-life-freedom-uprising-impunity-for-crimes-reigns-supreme/) | Amnesty said there had been no effective, impartial, or independent criminal investigations into security-force killings, torture, sexual violence, or enforced disappearances, and that authorities instead used harassment and arbitrary detention against victims’ families. This is strong evidence of tolerance for abuse and refusal to impose accountability. | `3B.2`, `3B.1` |
| `Iran: Security Forces Rape, Torture, Detainees` | Human Rights Watch | 2024-04-22 | [link](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/04/22/iran-security-forces-rape-torture-detainees) | HRW documented rape, torture, and sexual assault of detainees by security forces and noted that authorities had not investigated or held anyone accountable. This is strong evidence that abusive behavior by coercive organs was tolerated, not punished. | `3B.2`, `3B.1` |
| `Iran remains one of the world’s top practitioners of the death penalty` | Human Rights Watch | 2024-01-11 | [link](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/iran-chokehold-dissent) | HRW reported that Iranian authorities had killed hundreds of protesters, arrested thousands, tortured detainees, and failed to open transparent investigations into security-force abuse. This supports a pattern of tolerated coercion rather than restraint or discipline. | `3B.2`, `3B.1` |
| `Ayatollah Khamenei pardons, commutes sentences of over 2,000 prisoners` | Press TV | 2024-04-06 | [link](https://www.presstv.ir/Detail/2024/04/06/723171/-Supreme-Leader-Ayatollah-Khamenei-pardons-commutes-sentences-of-over-2%2C000-Iranian-inmates) | Khamenei approved pardons or commutations for 2,127 inmates for Eid/Nowruz. This is a limited positive signal, but it was discretionary clemency, not discipline of abusive police or intelligence services. | `3B.2`, `3B.1` |
| `Leader approves pardoning, commuting sentences of about 3,000 Iranian convicts` | Press TV | 2024-09-20 | [link](https://www.presstv.ir/Detail/2024/09/20/733636/Leader-approves-pardoning-convicts) | Khamenei approved clemency for 2,887 convicts, including some security-related cases. This is the strongest positive item I found, but it still does not show accountability for abuse by state coercive organs. | `3B.2`, `3B.1` |
| `Iran dissident group says six members sentenced to death` | Reuters | 2024-12-04 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iran-dissident-group-says-six-members-sentenced-to-death-3754608) | Reuters reported six dissidents sentenced to death on opposition-related charges amid a rise in new death sentences. This shows continued coercive punishment of dissidents rather than restraint of security institutions. | `3B.2`, `3B.1` |

**Assessment**

- **Positive evidence:** limited clemency decrees for selected prisoners, but no sign of structural discipline of abusive organs.
- **Negative evidence:** surveillance-heavy enforcement, torture, sexual violence, arbitrary detention, and a documented pattern of impunity.
- **Net reading:** Khamenei in 2024 **tolerated abuse** by police and security organs; I found **no credible evidence** that he punished them for it.

**Search gap**

- I did **not** find a reliable 2024 source showing Khamenei ordering investigations, prosecutions, dismissals, or other sanctions against police, intelligence, prison, militia, or vigilante perpetrators.
- I also did **not** find evidence of a public anti-abuse directive that was actually enforced. The clemency records are not substitutes for accountability.
